mainFindings: The download contract (UsageObservationDownloadSchema) still does not recompute sha256 from text: a producer could advertise a wrong digest and the envelope would be accepted. G asserts the real digest separately.

The header coverageState still folds any partial row into partial, so a completely enumerated source is served as 'partial'. The support report surfaces this as 'the observation is partial', which is true of the served document.
main's personal-preview tool defaults to the 4dcd28f inner tar. That tar does include the download chain; wave31's 'absent' claim was G's scan bug, corrected here.
